posts.headline: Forty-five editions in and Thicks finally forced my hand — Klint's Clipboard is 6-2 now, but 934.5 points-for still makes that ring the shakiest hardware in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A title in the trophy case means nothing when your career average finish sits at 5.5 and your scoring output trails half the league's winning teams.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers keep humming at 6-2 and triciagloston's 1128.92 points-for is now the single highest scoring total in the entire league.
posts.detail: One season of history and a modest 6-7-1 career mark didn't predict this — she's outscoring contenders and bottom-feeders alike.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra has slipped to 2-6 and the league's greatest-ever 1.5 average finish is now a punchline instead of a résumé.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and back-to-back trips to the title game mean nothing when you're sitting at 874.16 points with more losses than wins this year.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh finally got off the schneid but 1-7 with 798.32 points is still the worst product in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A career 12-average-finish and a 4-10 record don't lie — this roster was built for exactly this kind of season.

posts.headline: Sasinci is still stuck at 4-4 and Big Head's title defense has gone from embalmed to downright buried with a shovel.
posts.detail: 905.74 points-for from a former champ with a 13-15 career record is the definition of a ring that's aged like milk — fitting, for the Milk Man himself.
